title: Pagination boundary errors
difficulty_rationale: Single function in one file; three localized arithmetic/boundary defects; the docstring fully specifies the contract.
summary: paginate() returns the wrong slice, miscounts pages for partial last pages, and reports has_next incorrectly.
required_behavior: total_pages is ceil(len(items) / per_page); an empty list has total_pages == 0.
has_next is True only when page < total_pages; has_prev is True only when page > 1.
Page 1 of an empty list is valid and returns an empty page; any other page outside 1..total_pages raises ValueError.
acceptance_criteria: Hidden regression tests for unchanged behaviour (type of result, input validation) pass.
Public API (function name, parameters, Page fields) is unchanged.

acceptance_tests.description: Page 1 returns the first per_page items.
A partial last page is reachable and correctly sized.
has_next is False on the last page.
has_prev is False on page 1 and True afterwards.
Empty input returns an empty page 1 with total_pages 0.
Item counts that are exact multiples do not create an extra empty page.
